statement_summary: Title and object clause: the act establishes a Social Climate Fund and amends Regulation (EU) 2021/1060.
evidence_span: establishing a Social Climate Fund and amending Regulation (EU) 2021/1060

statement_summary: Legal basis citation of Treaty articles (formal citation, not an enacted provision).
evidence_span: Having regard to the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, and in particular Article 91(1), point (d), Article 192(1) and Article 194(2), and Article 322(1), point (a), thereof

statement_summary: The Regulation establishes the Social Climate Fund for the period 2026 to 2032.
evidence_span: This Regulation establishes the Social Climate Fund (the ‘Fund’) for the period from 2026 to 2032

statement_summary: The Fund provides financial support to Member States for measures and investments included in their Plans.
evidence_span: The Fund shall provide financial support to Member States for the measures and investments included in their Social Climate Plans (the ‘Plans’)

statement_summary: Measures and investments supported by the Fund are to benefit vulnerable households, micro-enterprises and transport users.
evidence_span: The measures and investments supported by the Fund shall benefit households, micro-enterprises and transport users, which are vulnerable and particularly affected by the inclusion of greenhouse gas emissions from buildings and road transport within the scope of Directive 2003/87/EC

statement_summary: Definition of 'financial allocation' as non-repayable financial support under the Fund allocated or available to a Member State.
evidence_span: ‘financial allocation’ means non-repayable financial support under the Fund that is available for allocation, or that has been allocated, to a Member State

statement_summary: Definitions of 'milestone' (qualitative achievement) and 'target' (quantitative achievement) measuring progress of a measure or investment.
evidence_span: ‘milestone’ means a qualitative achievement used to measure progress towards the achievement of a measure or an investment || ‘target’ means a quantitative achievement used to measure progress towards the achievement of a measure or investment

statement_summary: Definition of 'estimated total costs of the Plan'.
evidence_span: ‘estimated total costs of the Plan’ means the estimated total costs of the measures and investments included in the Plan

statement_summary: Definition of the category 'vulnerable households'.
evidence_span: ‘vulnerable households’ means households in energy poverty or households, including low income and lower middle-income ones, that are significantly affected by the price impacts of the inclusion of greenhouse gas emissions from buildings within the scope of Directive 2003/87/EC and lack the means to renovate the building they occupy

statement_summary: Definition of the category 'vulnerable micro-enterprises'.
evidence_span: ‘vulnerable micro-enterprises’ means micro-enterprises that are significantly affected by the price impacts of the inclusion of greenhouse gas emissions from buildings or road transport within the scope of Directive 2003/87/EC

statement_summary: Definition of the category 'vulnerable transport users'.
evidence_span: ‘vulnerable transport users’ means individuals and households in transport poverty, but also individuals and households, including low income and lower middle-income ones, that are significantly affected by the price impacts of the inclusion of greenhouse gas emissions from road transport within the scope of Directive 2003/87/EC

statement_summary: Definitions of 'household' and 'micro-enterprise' resting on definitions in other Union instruments.
evidence_span: ‘household’ means a private household as defined in Article 2, point (15), of Regulation (EU) 2019/1700 || ‘micro-enterprise’ means an enterprise that employs fewer than 10 persons and whose annual turnover or annual balance sheet does not exceed EUR 2 million, calculated in accordance with Articles 3 to 6 of Annex I to Commission Regulation (EU) No 651/2014

statement_summary: Definitions of energy-related and vehicle terms resting on definitions in other Union instruments.
evidence_span: means energy from renewable sources as defined in Article 2, second subparagraph, point (1), of Directive (EU) 2018/2001 || means an active customer as defined in Article 2, point (8), of Directive (EU) 2019/944 || as defined in Article 3(1), point (m), of Regulation (EU) 2019/631

statement_summary: General objective of the Fund: contribute to a socially fair transition towards climate neutrality by addressing social impacts of including buildings and road transport in Directive 2003/87/EC.
evidence_span: The general objective of the Fund shall be to contribute to a socially fair transition towards climate neutrality by addressing the social impacts of the inclusion of greenhouse gas emissions from buildings and road transport within the scope of Directive 2003/87/EC

statement_summary: Specific objectives of the Fund: support vulnerable households, micro-enterprises and transport users through temporary direct income support and measures and investments.
evidence_span: The specific objectives of the Fund shall be to support vulnerable households, vulnerable micro-enterprises and vulnerable transport users, through temporary direct income support and through measures and investments

statement_summary: Each Member State submits its Plan to the Commission.
evidence_span: Each Member State shall submit to the Commission its Plan

evidence_span: The Plan shall contain a coherent set of existing or new national measures and investments to address the impact of carbon pricing on vulnerable households, vulnerable micro-enterprises and vulnerable transport users

evidence_span: Each Member State shall ensure consistency between its Plan and its updated integrated national energy and climate plan referred to in Article 14(2) of Regulation (EU) 2018/1999

statement_summary: The Plan may include national measures providing temporary direct income support to vulnerable households and transport users.
evidence_span: The Plan may include national measures providing temporary direct income support to vulnerable households and vulnerable transport users

evidence_span: The Plan shall include national and, where relevant, local and regional measures and investments, in accordance with Article 8, to:

evidence_span: the national measures already in place to mitigate social impacts and challenges may be included in the Plan provided that they comply with this Regulation

statement_summary: Each Member State submits its Plan to the Commission following a public consultation with local and regional authorities, economic and social partners, civil society organisations, youth organisations and other stakeholders.
evidence_span: Each Member State shall submit a Plan to the Commission following a public consultation with local and regional authorities, representatives of economic and social partners, relevant civil society organisations, youth organisations and other stakeholders

evidence_span: Each Member State shall conduct that consultation in accordance with the requirements of Article 10 of Regulation (EU) 2018/1999 and in compliance with that Member State’s national legal framework

statement_summary: Each Member State includes in its Plan a summary of the consultation held and of how stakeholder input is reflected in the Plan.
evidence_span: Each Member State shall include in its Plan a summary of:

evidence_span: the Commission shall assess whether the Plan has been developed in consultation with stakeholders in accordance with paragraph 1 of this Article

statement_summary: The Commission supports Member States by providing examples of good practices of consultations on the Plans in accordance with Article 6(4).
evidence_span: The Commission shall support Member States by providing examples of good practices of consultations on the Plans in accordance with Article 6(4)

statement_summary: The Plan sets out listed elements (a) to (q): concrete measures, accompanying measures, financing information, estimates of price effects, identification of vulnerable groups, definitions, criteria for income support, milestones and targets, costs, national contribution, do-no-significant-harm explanation, monitoring arrangements, consultation summary, anti-fraud system explanation, geographic and gender considerations.
evidence_span: The Plan shall set out the following elements:

statement_summary: The Plan contains the arrangements for effective monitoring and implementation, including milestones, targets and the common indicators of Annex IV.
evidence_span: the arrangements for the effective monitoring and implementation of the Plan by the Member State concerned, in particular of the proposed milestones and targets, the relevant common indicators referred to in Annex IV

statement_summary: The Plan contains an explanation of the Member State's system to prevent, detect and correct fraud, corruption and conflicts of interests and avoid double funding.
evidence_span: an explanation of the Member State’s system to prevent, detect and correct fraud, corruption and conflicts of interests when using the financial allocation provided under the Fund

statement_summary: The Plan may include technical assistance actions.
evidence_span: The Plan may include technical assistance actions necessary for the effective administration and implementation of the measures and investments

statement_summary: The Plan is to be consistent with the information and commitments under six listed plans and programmes (Pillar Action Plan, cohesion programmes, recovery and resilience plan, building renovation plan, integrated national energy and climate plan, territorial just transition plans).
evidence_span: The Plan shall be consistent with the information included in and the commitments made by the Member State under the following:

evidence_span: the Commission shall organise an exchange of good practices, including on cost-effective measures and investments to be included in the Plans

statement_summary: Member States may request technical support under the ELENA facility or the Technical Support Instrument.
evidence_span: Member States may request technical support under the European Local ENergy Assistance (ELENA) facility, established by an Agreement between the Commission and the European Investment Bank in 2009, or under the Technical Support Instrument established by Regulation (EU) 2021/240

statement_summary: The Commission provides technical guidance to Member States on compliance of measures and investments with the 'do no significant harm' principle.
evidence_span: the Commission shall provide technical guidance to the Member States, tailored to the scope of the Fund, on the compliance of measures and investments with the principle of ‘do no significant harm’

statement_summary: To assist Member States the Commission provides a common value to be considered as an estimate for the carbon price.
evidence_span: the Commission shall provide a common value to be considered as an estimate for the carbon price resulting from the inclusion of greenhouse gas emissions from buildings, road transport and additional sectors within the scope of Directive 2003/87/EC

statement_summary: Each Member State uses the template set out in Annex V for the Plan.
evidence_span: Each Member State shall use the template set out in Annex V for the Plan

statement_summary: The Fund provides financial support to Member States to fund the measures and investments set out in their Plans.
evidence_span: The Fund shall provide financial support to Member States to fund the measures and investments set out in their Plans

statement_summary: Payment of financial support to each Member State is conditional upon that Member State achieving the milestones and targets in accordance with Article 8.
evidence_span: Payment of financial support pursuant to paragraph 1 of this Article to each Member State shall be conditional upon that Member State achieving the milestones and targets for the measures and investments in accordance with Article 8 of this Regulation

statement_summary: The milestones and targets are to be compatible with the Union's climate targets and Regulation (EU) 2021/1119 and cover energy efficiency, building renovation, mobility, emission reductions and reductions in vulnerable groups.
evidence_span: Those milestones and targets shall be compatible with the Union’s climate targets and the objective set out in Regulation (EU) 2021/1119, and shall cover in particular:

statement_summary: The Fund supports only measures and investments complying with the 'do no significant harm' principle of Article 17 of Regulation (EU) 2020/852.
evidence_span: The Fund shall only support measures and investments which comply with the principle of ‘do no significant harm’ within the meaning of Article 17 of Regulation (EU) 2020/852

statement_summary: Measures and investments supported by the Fund are to reduce fossil fuel dependency and, where relevant, contribute to the European Pillar of Social Rights and to jobs.
evidence_span: The measures and investments supported by the Fund shall reduce fossil fuel dependency

statement_summary: A Member State may include in the estimated total costs of the Plan listed categories of measures and investments with lasting impacts, provided they principally target vulnerable households, micro-enterprises or transport users.
evidence_span: The Member State may include in the estimated total costs of the Plan the following measures and investments with lasting impacts, provided they principally target vulnerable households, vulnerable micro-enterprises or vulnerable transport users and intend to:

statement_summary: Member States aim to ensure that support to zero-emission vehicles is prioritised in their Plans where affordable and deployable.
evidence_span: Member States shall aim to ensure that where zero-emission vehicles are an affordable and deployable solution, support to such vehicles is prioritised in their Plans

statement_summary: Member States may include in the estimated total costs the costs of measures providing direct income support to vulnerable households and transport users; such support is temporary and decreases over time.
evidence_span: Member States may include in the estimated total costs of the Plans the costs of measures providing direct income support to vulnerable households and vulnerable transport users to reduce the impact of the increase in road transport and heating fuel prices

statement_summary: Costs of temporary direct income support may not represent more than 37.5 % of the estimated total costs of the Plan.
evidence_span: The costs of measures providing temporary direct income support shall not represent more than 37,5 % of the estimated total costs of the Plan

statement_summary: Member States may provide temporary direct income support if their Plans contain measures or investments aimed at the same vulnerable groups under Article 8(1); support is limited to the direct impact of the inclusion of buildings and road transport in the ETS.
evidence_span: Member States may provide temporary direct income support if their Plans contain measures or investments aimed at those vulnerable households and vulnerable transport users in accordance with Article 8(1) of this Regulation

statement_summary: Member States may include in the estimated total costs the costs of technical assistance for management of the Fund and achievement of its objectives.
evidence_span: Member States may include in the estimated total costs of the Plans the costs of technical assistance

statement_summary: Costs of technical assistance are up to 2.5 % of the estimated total costs of the Plan.
evidence_span: The costs of such technical assistance shall be up to 2,5 % of the estimated total costs of the Plan

statement_summary: Member States may include in the Plans support provided through public or private entities other than the vulnerable groups, provided those entities carry out measures ultimately benefitting vulnerable households, micro-enterprises or transport users.
evidence_span: Member States may include in the Plans support provided through public or private entities other than vulnerable households, vulnerable micro-enterprises and vulnerable transport users, provided that those entities carry out measures and investments ultimately benefitting vulnerable households, vulnerable micro-enterprises or vulnerable transport users

statement_summary: Member States provide statutory and contractual safeguards to ensure that the entire benefit is passed on to vulnerable households, micro-enterprises or transport users.
evidence_span: Member States shall provide for the necessary statutory and contractual safeguards to ensure that the entire benefit is passed on to the vulnerable households, vulnerable micro-enterprises or vulnerable transport users

statement_summary: A maximum amount of EUR 65 000 000 000 for 2026-2032 is made available, in accordance with Articles 10a(8b), 30d(3) and 30d(4) of Directive 2003/87/EC, for implementation of the Fund; it constitutes external assigned revenue under the Financial Regulation.
evidence_span: A maximum amount of EUR 65 000 000 000 for the period from 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2032 in current prices shall be made available, in accordance with Articles 10a(8b), 30d(3) and 30d(4) of Directive 2003/87/EC, for implementation of the Fund

statement_summary: If the emission trading system under Chapter IVa of Directive 2003/87/EC is postponed until 2028 under Article 30k of that Directive, the maximum amount is EUR 54 600 000 000.
evidence_span: Where the emission trading system established in accordance with Chapter IVa of Directive 2003/87/EC is postponed until 2028 pursuant to Article 30k of that Directive, the maximum amount to be made available to the Fund shall be EUR 54 600 000 000

statement_summary: By derogation from Article 22(2) of the Financial Regulation, commitment appropriations are made available automatically at the start of each financial year from 1 January 2026.
evidence_span: commitment appropriations covering the relevant maximum amount referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall be made available automatically at the beginning of each financial year, starting from 1 January 2026

statement_summary: The amounts may also cover preparatory, monitoring, control, audit, evaluation and other technical and administrative expenses incurred by the Commission for management of the Fund.
evidence_span: all other technical and administrative assistance expenses incurred by the Commission for the management of the Fund

evidence_span: Resources allocated to Member States under shared management may, at their request, be transferred to the Fund subject to the conditions set out in the relevant provisions of Regulation (EU) 2021/1060

evidence_span: The Commission shall implement those resources directly in accordance with Article 62(1), first subparagraph, point (a), of Regulation (EU, Euratom) 2018/1046

evidence_span: Those resources shall be used exclusively for the benefit of the Member State concerned

evidence_span: Member States may request in their Plans submitted in accordance with Article 4(1) of this Regulation for the transfer of up to 15 % of their maximum annual financial allocation to the funds under shared management provided for in Regulation (EU) 2021/1060

evidence_span: Resources shall be transferred by Member States through the amendment of one or more programmes, except for programmes under the European territorial cooperation goal (Interreg), in accordance with Article 26a of Regulation (EU) 2021/1060

evidence_span: Member States may entrust the managing authorities of the cohesion policy programmes under Regulation (EU) 2021/1060 with the implementation of measures and investments benefitting from the Fund

statement_summary: Member States state in their Plans their intention to entrust those authorities.

statement_summary: Those costs do not exceed 4 % of the maximum financial allocation for the Plan.
evidence_span: Those costs shall not exceed 4 % of the maximum financial allocation for the Plan

evidence_span: The Fund shall be implemented by the Commission under direct management in accordance with the relevant rules adopted pursuant to Article 322 TFEU

evidence_span: Support under the Fund shall be additional to the support provided under other Union funds, programmes and instruments

evidence_span: Each Member State may submit a request up to its maximum financial allocation to implement its Plan

statement_summary: Member States contribute at least 25 % of the estimated total costs of their Plans.
evidence_span: Member States shall contribute at least to 25 % of the estimated total costs of their Plans

evidence_span: The Commission shall assess the Plan and, where applicable, any amendment to that Plan submitted by a Member State in accordance with Article 18, for compliance with this Regulation

evidence_span: When carrying out that assessment, the Commission shall act in close cooperation with the Member State concerned

evidence_span: The Commission shall assess the amended Plan in accordance with Article 16

evidence_span: Those assessments shall be submitted to the Commission together with the integrated national energy and climate progress reports pursuant to Article 17 of Regulation (EU) 2018/1999
